info.title: dorn
info.description: Dorn — community scaffolding CLI for .NET, Clean Architecture templates.

commands.name: webapi
commands.description: Generate a Clean Architecture Web API project.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output directory for the generated project. Defaults
to ./<name>

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files in the output directory

options.name: --database
options.description:
Database provider: sqlite (default) or sqlserver.
Prompted interactively if omitted and the session is
interactive

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Name of the project to generate
